probe.name: Ionic Assault Probe
title: IONIC ASSAULT
PROBE
probe.description: Deals {damage} HP to one target. Only dealing actual damage marks that target for Thunder Hammer in this turn or your next turn. Normal defenses and cover apply.

hammer.name: Thunder Hammer
title: THUNDER
HAMMER
hammer.description: Deals {damage} HP with one hit. A valid Ionic Assault Probe mark adds a separate {bonus} HP hit on that target if it remains alive, consuming the mark. Works independently without a mark. Normal defenses and cover apply to each hit.
